title: Phase 1 base game foundation
details: Main menu, Blacksite map, dual 3D/2D renderers, core weapons, round system, economy, HUD, game over flow, and procedural audio are complete.

title: Environment detail pass for Blacksite
details: Add sixteen prop kinds (fence, jersey barrier, pipe, pallet, dumpster, tank, generator, guard tower, comms mast, floodlight, fire barrel, wreck, rubble, dead tree, cone, sign, puddle), pass-through decor props, volumetric light shafts, lamp flicker, animated fire/smoke/dust/stars, and map data-integrity tests. Dresses Blacksite as a working compound without changing how it plays.

title: Add substation and cold store regions to Blacksite
details: Extend Blacksite from two regions to four: a substation opening off the spawn yard for 1000 points and a cold store behind the vault for 1250, each with its own barriers, terrain, dressing and wall-buy (Lancer-7 and Havoc-9). Makes playBounds a union of per-wing rects, names doors in the HUD prompt, renders a mesh per door, and pools the 3D point lights so room count no longer drives GPU cost.

title: Fix movement, camera, and collision feel
details: Address playtest feedback: rotated props now collide as oriented boxes and round props as discs so bounding-box corners stop acting as invisible walls; multi-part props such as the guard tower collide as their legs; the chase camera pulls in and fades the player when geometry is behind them; keyboard turning (Q/E and arrows) plus persisted look-sensitivity, turn-speed and invert-Y settings in the pause menu make the game playable on a trackpad. Also fixes a player cage whose wing rects did not overlap, which made the substation and cold store doors impassable.

title: Ship map-select menu
details: Add a map-select menu so players can choose between maps instead of swapping the default map in code.

title: Build four additional Phase 1 maps
details: Create the remaining planned maps so Phase 1 has a broader playable map set beyond Blacksite.

title: Add perks and The Cache mystery box
details: Implement Ironhide, Rapid Rounds, Fast Hands, Second Wind, and the Mystery Box feature (The Cache).

title: Add grenades, ADS, and map progression extensions
details: Implement grenades, aim-down-sights, more map regions, and board-up barriers.

title: Add The Forge upgrades and Feral-Hound rounds
details: Implement weapon upgrades at The Forge and special dog/Feral-Hound rounds.

title: Add power systems, power-ups, and second map
details: Implement power-ups (Resupply/Executioner/Purge/Bonus/Fortify), the power switch, and a second map.

title: Add boss rounds, traps, and mini-quests
details: Introduce boss encounters and objective-style side content.

title: Add easter eggs, settings, and leaderboards
details: Deliver musical/main-quest easter eggs, difficulty/settings controls, and leaderboard support.
